title: CHAOS Source Record Observation V1
description: Versioned source observation with separate logical identity and content-version identity. Transport metadata is excluded from both identities.

event_time.description: Native event or observation time; may be YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, or timezone-aware ISO-8601.

available_at.description: When this exact vintage became available to the system. Null means point-in-time eligibility is unknown.

source_record_id.description: Stable source identifier, when the provider guarantees its stability across revisions.

logical_key.description: Explicitly declared natural key. For periodic_measurement only, entity_id + metric_id + event_time is the canonical default slot key. Event streams and period counts have no inferred logical key.

transport_metadata.description: Audit-only metadata. Never contributes to logical_record_id or canonical_record_id.
